front: MOST effective first step to find AI opportunities
back: Work backwards from business and customer problems, then map AI capabilities and measurable outcomes. Bắt đầu từ problem và KPI, không bắt đầu từ model.

front: Quick win in a value-feasibility matrix
back: High business value and high feasibility: data ready, skills available, short timeline. "Quick win" là cách gọi phổ biến, AWS chỉ nói prioritize theo value và feasibility.

front: Four prioritization criteria in AIB-C01 Task 2.1
back: Business value, feasibility, sustainability, strategic alignment. Value cao nhưng lệch chiến lược vẫn có thể bị cắt.

ref.label: AWS blog, GenAI blueprint for CEOs and CIOs

front: Pilot met predefined success criteria with positive ROI
back: Scale in phases and look for similar use cases. ML Lens khuyên mở rộng model có ROI dương sang bài toán tương tự.

front: ROI still negative after remediation
back: Terminate (sunset) and reallocate resources; ignore sunk cost. Tiền đã chi không phải lý do để tiếp tục.

front: Value proven, but a data or skills gap blocks production
back: Pause, fix the blocker, then re-evaluate. Pause khác terminate: use case vẫn đáng làm.

front: FASTEST time to value, LEAST operational overhead
back: Buy a SaaS product or managed AI service. Đổi lại ít khác biệt vì đối thủ mua được cùng thứ.

ref.label: AWS Executive Insights, cost and ROI of GenAI

front: Core differentiator built on proprietary data
back: Customize a foundation model with your data, or build custom; keep ownership of the data and models. Đây là chỗ không nên buy generic.

front: No in-house AI skills but needs a tailored solution quickly
back: Partner, with a knowledge transfer plan. Partner bù skill và rút ngắn timeline.

front: Consolidate billing and negotiate custom terms for third-party AI tools
back: AWS Marketplace: charges on the AWS bill, free trials, private offers with custom pricing and EULA. Express private offer cho offer tùy chỉnh trong vài phút.

front: Outcome can be computed with simple, fixed rules
back: Use rule-based automation, not AI. AI cho kết quả xác suất, rule cho kết quả lặp lại và dễ audit.

front: Baseline for judging whether ML is worth it
back: Compare the ML solution with the existing or rules-based approach before investing. ML phải vượt baseline đủ để bù total cost.

front: MINIMIZE disruption when replacing a process with AI
back: Parallel run, phased rollout, human fallback, rollback plan. Giữ business continuity trong lúc chuyển.

front: Model on your AI platform enters Legacy status
back: Plan migration before end of life; evaluate replacements on your own dataset. Với model Bedrock ra mắt từ 2026-09-07, Legacy period thường là 6 tháng, có model chỉ 45 ngày.

front: BEST way to accurately measure AI impact
back: Capture baseline metrics before launch and compare with a control group. Không có baseline thì cải thiện chỉ là ước đoán.

front: Tangible vs intangible KPI
back: Tangible: cost reduction, revenue growth, time savings. Intangible: customer satisfaction, employee productivity and satisfaction. Intangible vẫn đo được bằng survey có baseline.

front: Leading indicator of AI success
back: Adoption rate, active users, first-draft usability rate, task completion. Leading indicator đo sớm và dự báo ROI, revenue về sau.

front: Link model metrics to business goals
back: OGSM: Objectives, Goals, Strategies, Measures. Mỗi metric kỹ thuật phải truy được về một business goal.

front: ROI and payback period formulas
back: ROI = (total benefit - total cost) / total cost. Payback = one-time cost / annual net benefit. Total cost gồm cả run cost nhiều năm.

front: Estimate AWS cost BEFORE building, for a business case
back: AWS Pricing Calculator: free, upfront, monthly and annual estimates, export to CSV or PDF. Cost Explorer chỉ dùng khi đã có usage thực.

front: Analyze actual AI spend by team and forecast it
back: Cost allocation tags plus AWS Cost Explorer: 13 months of history, 18-month forecast. Tag theo project và business unit để chargeback.

front: Steady SageMaker AI instance usage for years
back: SageMaker AI Savings Plans: up to 64% off On-Demand for a 1- or 3-year commitment. Chỉ trả lại được trong 7 ngày nếu cam kết từ 100 USD mỗi giờ trở xuống.

front: Non-urgent, large-volume Bedrock job at LOWEST cost
back: Batch inference (50% lower than on-demand for supported models) or the Flex tier. Priority tier thì ngược lại, có premium.

front: SUSTAINABLE competitive advantage from AI
back: A proprietary data flywheel embedded in workflows; model access alone is not defensible. CAF-AI gọi data hiếm và khó sao chép là defensive moat.

front: Do Savings Plans cover Amazon Bedrock?
back: No. Savings Plans cover EC2, Fargate, Lambda and SageMaker AI. For Bedrock commitments, use the Reserved tier (1 or 3 months) or Provisioned Throughput (1 or 6 months). Đề gài Compute Savings Plans cho Bedrock là sai.

front: AI usage is high but the business sees no margin impact
back: Adoption is a leading indicator, not value. Redesign workflows across functions and measure business KPIs against a baseline. Dùng nhiều chưa chắc ra tiền.

ref.label: HBR, The Deployment Failure Holding Back Your AI Investments (10/2026)

front: A simpler, less compute-intensive approach gets the same outcome
back: Do not use GenAI; the GenAI Lens says always ask whether GenAI is the right solution. Đơn giản hơn thì rẻ hơn và bền vững hơn.
